name: st_lrps_fit_region_sweep
description: Locate the SH-degree region where ST-LRPS sits. CPU DOP853 SH200 truth vs a GPU RK4 SH degree ladder (20-200) plus ST-LRPS both on GPU RK4 and on the CPU adaptive truth integrator. The SH200 GPU RK4 series isolates fixed-step integrator/dtype/frame error (the floor every GPU series inherits); the adaptive surrogate series reports surrogate-dominated trajectory error with the fixed-step integrator contribution substantially reduced but NOT independently eliminated (its tolerances are looser than the truth run's, so tolerance/truncation/dtype residuals remain entangled with the field error); the SH ladder anchors the equivalent-degree estimate; runtime rows carry the speed comparison including speedup vs the DOP853 truth.

validation.truth_baseline_justification: SH200 on the GPU fixed-step integrator shares the truth gravity field; its error against the SH200 DOP853 truth isolates integrator/dtype/frame error, the floor every other GPU series inherits. Without it the ST-LRPS error cannot be attributed between field and integrator contributions.
